topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I can't believe this! Someone sends me a whole bouquet and doesn't even have the decency to attach a note. What’s the point of sending something if you’re just gonna be all secretive about it? It’s like, okay, I get the flowers are pretty and all, but what’s the message? What do you want from me? Do you expect me to play some kind of guessing game? I’d rather just have a straight-up talk than this cryptic nonsense. At least if you’re gonna say something, say it properly!
